named_expectations.name: 月亮 has an L1 CCFD illumination feature (有-光 class)
named_expectations.detail: matched features under the RULED regex: ['可以-发光', '是-不发光的'] (modal 可以-发光 @ 0.138)
named_expectations.finding: 月亮's HIGHEST-rate illumination-language feature in CCFD is 有-光 (has-light, 9/29 = 0.310) — the ruled regex does not carry a pattern that reaches 有-光 or 是-亮的; the match above rides on 可以-发光/是-不发光的. Widening the regex is HER call, not this build's.
